speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked the Minister for Transport whether the Ministry receives complaints and feedback on reckless behaviour of PMD users for near-misses or accidents and, if so, what process is undertaken by the Ministry when it receives such complaints and feedback.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: LTA also uses such information to enhance its enforcement, public education and engagement efforts.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: LTA also shares the information with the relevant Active Mobility Patrol teams so that they can patrol the area more frequently to engage the community and distribute educational materials.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Many of my elderly residents, when they walk on the park connectors, they do not feel safe anymore.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Not just the elderly, in fact, a lot of residents when they meet me in the park connectors, they just feel it is so dangerous.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: So, I hope the Senior Minister of State can consider tougher actions against errant riders.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: I do share the same concern as well.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: If Members take a step back and look at the entire landscape, footpaths form a significant part of our connectivity network, connecting from point A to point B, from homes to places of work, places of schooling as well as recreation.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: And if we do disallow active mobility devices on footpaths, basically, what it means is that active mobility users would have to operate on roads.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: That actually poses more risks to both the active mobility users and other vehicles, including motorbikes, cars, lorries, trucks or even buses.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: We do agree that active mobility plays an important role in our vision to making Singapore a car-lite society.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: We should instead cultivate a culture of graciousness, responsibility and respect in sharing the use of our common space.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: The mandatory e-scooter registration regime will be in force from 1 July 2019.
